limits: Banner visibility is not exclusive causality or proof that changing networking resolves any case.
Twelve cases flag obvious additional content/state differences; this is not an exhaustive pixel segmentation of the other cases.
Small rendering shifts and the absent Back to bottom pill require separate ownership/context review. No baseline intent or product regression verdict inferred.
No fresh screenshots, application replay, forced clicks, baseline replacements, source-container restart or cleanup.
Raw images/receipts remain local, not a complete durable archive. Historical reading/journal gaps are not reconciled.
No blanket baseline update is proposed; existing six-provider-pair authorization question remains unanswered.
nextDecision: User approval of intended provider/model baseline content and targeted fresh capture/update scope remains required. Other visual differences and nonvisual failures remain unwaived.
